arcs.title: The Porch Railing Situation
arcs.summary: Day 4 (Friday): The railing spent the day in silence. Steve has located the level. Don's portrait is confident. Adam arrives Saturday. Resolution files Saturday: the joint inspection, the level, the oak, the bracket question, a verdict that is satisfying, funny, and slightly vindicating for Don. Resolve this arc in Saturday's edition.

arcs.title: The Duck Bandit Chronicles
arcs.summary: Day 2: A second duck (the Admiral) has been given a miniature captain's hat of unknown origin. The orange-scarf twelfth duck remains dressed. The wool matches no known manufacturer. Two other wizarding Jeep owners in separate locations have reported similar incidents — a ribbon, a moved duck — suggesting the Duck Bandit operates regionally, possibly nationally. The Gorge ducks were found unadorned Friday morning. Day 3 should develop the Bandit's apparent methodology or motivation — perhaps a pattern emerges across the accessorised ducks (they all share something in common), or a witness account surfaces, or the hat's provenance is partially traced.
